name: Grape Juice
siboNotes: Generally well tolerated on SIBO diet as it contains no significant FODMAPs, though some may be sensitive to natural fruit sugars.
preparationTips: Choose 100% pure grape juice without added high fructose corn syrup
Dilute with water if you find it too sweet or concentrated
Serve chilled for best flavor and digestive comfort
Read labels carefully to avoid added fructose or artificial sweeteners
alternatives: Lemon or lime juice diluted with water
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C and antioxidants
